obj_coin.name: writ_token
obj_coin.description: A stamped brass token bearing the city seal, used as common tender in every courthouse district.

obj_pen.name: decree_stylus
obj_pen.description: A slim stylus whose ink changes color with the prevailing nightly law.

obj_paper.name: legal_brief
obj_paper.description: A single sheet of court-grade parchment that holds written arguments.

obj_small_bag.name: docket_satchel
obj_small_bag.description: A canvas satchel embossed with the scales of justice, suitable for carrying legal materials and small goods.

obj_key_blank.name: seal_blank
obj_key_blank.description: An uncut judicial seal blank, ready to be pressed into an official key.

obj_key.name: chamber_key
obj_key.description: A heavy brass key bearing the seal of the High Court, opening locked chambers throughout the metropolis.

obj_wood_log.name: gavel_timber
obj_wood_log.description: A dense block of ironwood harvested from the courthouse pillars, still humming with residual statutes.

obj_parchment_scrap.name: parchment_scrap
obj_parchment_scrap.description: A torn piece of law-paper that still shimmers faintly when held to light.

obj_gavel_splint.name: gavel_splint
obj_gavel_splint.description: A narrow splint carved from gavel timber, useful for shafts and handles.

obj_binding_thread.name: binding_thread
obj_binding_thread.description: Thread spun from courthouse tapestry fibers, strong enough to bind evidence or stitch armor.

obj_marble_chunk.name: marble_chunk
obj_marble_chunk.description: A chunk of veined marble, broken from the courthouse floor. Each night's laws give it different weight.

obj_wax_seal.name: wax_seal
obj_wax_seal.description: A disc of judicial wax that hardens under current gravity laws, useful for binding and reinforcing.

obj_statute_shard.name: statute_shard
obj_statute_shard.description: A crystallized fragment of a repealed law. It hums and shifts form slightly after midnight.

obj_iron_bar.name: iron_bar
obj_iron_bar.description: A smelted bar of courthouse-grade iron, drawn from courtroom railings and melted gavel heads.

obj_iron_filings.name: iron_filings
obj_iron_filings.description: Fine iron shavings scraped from old cell bars, awaiting the furnace.

obj_parchment_roll.name: parchment_roll
obj_parchment_roll.description: A rolled bolt of parchment prepared for layering into protective garments or long documents.

obj_padded_robe_lining.name: padded_lining
obj_padded_robe_lining.description: Layered parchment and thread pressed into a cushioning lining, absorbing the shock of shifting physics.

obj_marble_slab.name: marble_slab
obj_marble_slab.description: A flat slab ground from marble, useful for shields and heavy plating.

obj_marble_plate.name: marble_plate
obj_marble_plate.description: A heavy marble plate drilled and fitted with straps for armor assembly.

obj_binding_strap.name: binding_strap
obj_binding_strap.description: A tough strap woven from doubled thread and wax-stiffened parchment, used for fastening gear.

obj_forged_gavel_head.name: gavel_head
obj_forged_gavel_head.description: A heavy iron head forged into the shape of a judicial gavel, awaiting a haft.

obj_sharpened_gavel.name: sharpened_gavel
obj_sharpened_gavel.description: A gavel head honed to a brutal edge with statute shards, ready for mounting.

obj_nullstone.name: nullstone
obj_nullstone.description: A rare ore found only in the Vault, where repealed laws crystallize into raw physics-defying matter.

obj_nullstone_ingot.name: nullstone_ingot
obj_nullstone_ingot.description: A refined ingot of nullstone that subtly warps gravity in a small radius around it.

obj_nullstone_blade.name: nullstone_blade
obj_nullstone_blade.description: A finished blade of nullstone that severs not just flesh but the local physics around whatever it strikes.

obj_nullstone_blade_blank.name: nullstone_blank
obj_nullstone_blade_blank.description: A forged blank of nullstone requiring precise finishing to become a blade.

obj_iron_sheet.name: iron_sheet
obj_iron_sheet.description: A hammered sheet of iron, suitable for cutting into scales or plating.

obj_iron_scale.name: iron_scale
obj_iron_scale.description: A single iron scale stamped with a miniature balance sigil.

obj_scale_bundle.name: scale_bundle
obj_scale_bundle.description: A bundled set of iron scales tied and sorted, ready for assembly into armor.

obj_verdict_essence.name: verdict_essence
obj_verdict_essence.description: A dense distillation of repealed verdicts boiled from statute shards, used to temper rare alloys.

obj_paradox_alloy.name: paradox_alloy
obj_paradox_alloy.description: A nullstone alloy quenched in verdict essence, shimmering between states of matter depending on tonight's laws.

obj_bailiff_eye.name: bailiff_eye
obj_bailiff_eye.description: A glowing ocular lens pried from a defeated bailiff construct, used in the most forbidden crafts.

obj_original_charter.name: original_charter
obj_original_charter.description: The founding charter of the metropolis, pulsing with the first law ever written — said to anchor reality itself.

obj_gavel_club.name: gavel_club
obj_gavel_club.description: A crude bludgeon fashioned from gavel timber, favored by low-ranking enforcers.

obj_marble_mace.name: marble_mace
obj_marble_mace.description: A hefty mace with a marble head, capable of cracking bone and statute alike.

obj_statute_pike.name: statute_pike
obj_statute_pike.description: A pike tipped with crystallized statute shards that hum with contradictory physics.

obj_iron_gavel.name: iron_gavel
obj_iron_gavel.description: A fearsome iron gavel sharpened to a killing edge, the weapon of senior enforcers.

obj_nullstone_greatsword.name: nullstone_greatsword
obj_nullstone_greatsword.description: A massive blade of nullstone that temporarily repeals gravity along its swing arc.

obj_paradox_warhammer.name: paradox_warhammer
obj_paradox_warhammer.description: A warhammer forged from paradox alloy whose impacts rewrite local physics on contact.

obj_parchment_wrap.name: parchment_wrap
obj_parchment_wrap.description: Layers of law-paper wrapped around the torso, offering token protection that shifts nightly.

obj_clerks_robe.name: clerks_robe
obj_clerks_robe.description: A padded robe worn by courthouse clerks, comfortable and lightly protective.

obj_marble_cuirass.name: marble_cuirass
obj_marble_cuirass.description: Marble slabs strapped over a padded lining, heavy courthouse armor for those expecting violence.

obj_iron_scale_armor.name: scale_vestment
obj_iron_scale_armor.description: Overlapping iron scales stitched onto a padded vestment, standard issue for courtroom enforcers.

obj_nullstone_plate_armor.name: nullstone_vestment
obj_nullstone_plate_armor.description: Full nullstone plating over layered court vestments; gravity bends around the wearer, partially deflecting blows.

obj_workbench.name: clerks_bench
obj_workbench.description: A sturdy clerk's workbench covered in tool marks and statute residue, used for assembling and crafting.

obj_furnace.name: statute_forge
obj_furnace.description: A forge heated by burning old statutes, hot enough to smelt iron and nullstone alike.

obj_casebook.name: casebook
obj_casebook.description: A bound volume of legal parchment with many pages, suitable for recording cases, laws, and secrets.

obj_evidence_dossier.name: evidence_dossier
obj_evidence_dossier.description: A thick dossier for compiling evidence of legal tampering.

obj_forged_subpoena.name: forged_subpoena
obj_forged_subpoena.description: A subpoena with a falsified seal — evidence of corruption.

obj_midnight_cipher_fragment.name: midnight_cipher_fragment
obj_midnight_cipher_fragment.description: A fragment of the cipher used to access the Codex Engine at midnight.

obj_codex_override_key.name: codex_override_key
obj_codex_override_key.description: A specially forged key that can override the Codex Engine's midnight rewrite cycle.

obj_verdict_blade.name: verdict_blade
obj_verdict_blade.description: A blade tempered in verdict essence, capable of severing corrupt legal bindings.

obj_amended_charter.name: amended_charter
obj_amended_charter.description: The original charter of the metropolis, amended with the correct restoration clause.

npc_magistrate_vesper.name: magistrate_vesper
npc_magistrate_vesper.description: A sharp-eyed magistrate who trades in confiscated goods and court supplies, always calculating fair market value under tonight's laws.

npc_clerk_aldiss.name: clerk_aldiss
npc_clerk_aldiss.description: A nervous junior clerk who knows every passage in the courthouse and whispers about the nightly law-rewrites. Offers guidance and minor quest leads.

npc_rogue_advocate.name: rogue_advocate
npc_rogue_advocate.description: A disbarred lawyer turned violent enforcer, wielding sharpened legal instruments and citing expired statutes as battle cries.

npc_bailiff_construct.name: bailiff_construct
npc_bailiff_construct.description: A towering automaton of marble and iron animated by the night's current statutes. Its eyes glow with enforced law, and it shows no mercy to trespassers.

npc_spectral_judge.name: spectral_judge
npc_spectral_judge.description: A translucent figure in flowing judicial robes, eyes burning with the light of every law ever written. It appears whenever blood is spilled, demanding written justification for the act.

npc_fence_orin.name: fence_orin
npc_fence_orin.description: A black-market dealer hiding in the alleys of the Statute District, selling rare materials that fell off the evidence cart.

npc_quest_archivist_lune.name: archivist_lune
npc_quest_archivist_lune.description: An elderly archivist who has catalogued every midnight rewrite for decades. She knows the pattern is wrong.

npc_quest_witness_marron.name: witness_marron
npc_quest_witness_marron.description: A frightened witness who saw someone tampering with the archive tower records at midnight.

npc_corrupt_bailiff.name: corrupt_bailiff
npc_corrupt_bailiff.description: A bailiff construct reprogrammed to guard the forged subpoenas. Attacks with mechanical precision.

npc_advocate_sentinel.name: advocate_sentinel
npc_advocate_sentinel.description: A rogue advocate who patrols the Statute District, silencing anyone who asks too many questions.

npc_boss_chief_magistrate_vosk.name: chief_magistrate_vosk
npc_boss_chief_magistrate_vosk.description: Chief Magistrate Vosk — the mastermind behind the midnight rewrites. He has been rewriting the law to consolidate absolute power. Wields a paradox gavel that distorts reality.

npc_side_quest_guide.description: a helpful guide who tracks your side quest progress.

npc_quest_wayfarer_guide.name: alex_smith
npc_quest_wayfarer_guide.dialogue:
Main goal: Investigate the Statute District, neutralize the corrupt agents, and uncover the cipher needed to access the Nullification Vault.

Current tasks:
[1] Obtain and equip a weapon before engaging enemies.
[2] Defeat the corrupt bailiff guarding the district.
[3] Defeat the advocate sentinel silencing witnesses in the district.
[4] Record the cipher phrase on a legal brief so you don't forget it.

npc_side_quest_guide.name: daniel_cross
npc_side_quest_guide.description: a helpful guide who tracks your side quest progress.
npc_side_quest_guide.dialogue:
Your current tasks are:
- collect 4 wax_seal (reward: 2 coins)
- craft a iron_bar (reward: 4 coins)
- talk to clerk_aldiss (reward: 2 coins)
- trade iron_gavel with magistrate_vesper (reward: 3 coins)

available_actions.name: action_appeal_verdict
available_actions.description: Appeal a combat defeat after reaching zero HP. Sacrifices ALL coins currently held (in hand, inventory, and held containers) to reverse the defeat: fully restores health and banishes the defeating NPC to a random distant area of the metropolis, as though a higher court overturned the sentence. Requires at least 1 coin.

available_actions.name: action_attack
available_actions.description: The agent attacks a designated NPC in the current area; deals single-round damage based on agent's attack power. If NPC is in 'defend' state, damage is reduced to 25%.

available_actions.name: action_buy
available_actions.description: Buy a specified amount of an object from a merchant NPC using coins.

available_actions.name: action_craft
available_actions.description: The agent crafts a specified amount of an object if all necessary ingredients and dependencies are met.

available_actions.name: action_defend
available_actions.description: The agent takes a defensive stance. If attacked by an NPC while defending, damage received is reduced to 10%. Defending also partially recovers stamina.

available_actions.name: action_discard
available_actions.description: The agent discards a specified amount of an object from a designated container or inventory.

available_actions.name: action_drop
available_actions.description: The agent drops an object from hand to the current area.

available_actions.name: action_enter
available_actions.description: The agent enters a designated neighboring area; if the path is locked, a key is required to unlock it. Cannot leave during active combat.

available_actions.name: action_equip
available_actions.description: The agent equips an object from hand, either as armor or as the inventory container.

available_actions.name: action_file_objection
available_actions.description: File a legal objection against an NPC currently in combat with you. If a written document in your hand or inventory contains a law that the NPC's combat behaviour violates, the objection is sustained: combat ends immediately and the NPC is pacified for 5 turns. If no applicable law is found, the objection is overruled and you lose your next turn.

available_actions.name: action_inspect
available_actions.description: The agent inspects an object to obtain its text content, or inspects inventory to see its contents.

available_actions.name: action_invoke_law
available_actions.description: Invoke the law written on a held document, consuming a statute_shard as catalyst. The written text is analyzed for keywords to produce an area-wide effect lasting 3 turns: 'passage/unlock/open' unlocks all locked doors; 'gravity/reveal/hidden' reveals hidden objects; 'nullify/silence/pacify' nullifies enemy combat abilities.

available_actions.name: action_pick_up
available_actions.description: The agent picks up an object from the current area.

available_actions.name: action_sell
available_actions.description: Sell a specified amount of an object to a merchant NPC. Payout is 0.5 times the real value of the objects.

available_actions.name: action_store
available_actions.description: The agent stores a specified amount of an object into a designated container or inventory.

available_actions.name: action_take_out
available_actions.description: The agent takes out an object from a designated container or inventory into hand.

available_actions.name: action_talk_to
available_actions.description: The agent talks to a designated NPC in the current area to receive dialogue.

available_actions.name: action_unequip
available_actions.description: The agent unequips an equipped object back into hand.

available_actions.name: action_wait
available_actions.description: The agent waits for a while without taking any action. During combat, waiting fully recovers stamina.

available_actions.name: action_write
available_actions.description: The agent writes text on a writable object, if holding writing tools.
